basis: No Track 4 target, fill, ledger observation, or prospective performance has been created or inspected.

preserved_original_terms.earnings_policy: Earnings-event names receive IBS score 0.50 and are excluded from overnight selection, as explicitly specified in the original preregistration.
preserved_original_terms.track_4b_order: liquidity quintile -> NSI/Quality exclusions -> earnings treatment -> IBS ranking -> top-quintile selection

concentration_correction.reason: The original 50-name floor assumed the top 20% of the 260-320 liquidity-filtered universe before NSI/Quality exclusions and earnings removal. Under the registered ordering, 294 -> 207 after exclusions -> 201 non-earnings tradable names -> floor(201/5)=40 holdings. The 50-name floor is structurally inconsistent with the original selection chain.
concentration_correction.replacement_rule: For Track 4B, require exact top-quintile construction after all registered filters and flag final holdings < 40. The original >=50 diagnostic remains printed as SUPERSEDED_BY_AMENDMENT for provenance.

execution_audit.reason: Current code calculates day-t IBS from final post-close official Sharadar OHLC, selects the portfolio after that calculation, and assigns the same official close as the entry fill. The portfolio was not knowable before the entry price.
execution_audit.effect: Track 4 cannot be authorized or launched under the current implementation, regardless of user launch approval.
execution_audit.required_remediation: Implement and separately audit a PIT-safe pre-close signal and executable closing-auction (or later) entry-price source. No performance data may be used to select that design.

predeclared_cost_sensitivities.relative_to_weekly_track_1_at_10bps_x_52: Daily 10bp cost exceeds weekly full-turnover 10bp cost by 20.00 percentage points/year. A 2% net-alpha acceptance threshold therefore requires 22.00 percentage points of daily gross annual advantage versus Track 1 before cost.
